verdict.rationale: Cekura offers custom dashboards for call data, metrics, and metadata, and it lists per-metric evaluation costs in credits. Nothing in the evidence shows dashboards that track cost or token usage per request, per model, or over time. The general dashboards and the cost-reduction sampling feature are adjacent capabilities, not the cost-monitoring story itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards
